title: Relay on Bolt
brief: Relay's main window on DBFlux's Bolt design system (islands, 45 degree cuts, Archivo and JetBrains Mono, compact density) with strict visual hierarchy. Iterating here until the accent and the details are settled.

artboards.title: Bolt as DBFlux ships it
artboards.tradeoff: Reference: DBFlux's byzantine accent and its original emphasis, before the hierarchy rules

artboards.title: Cobalt accent
artboards.tradeoff: Cleanest separation from every semantic color; blue is the most common dev-tool accent, and POST moved to orange

artboards.title: Emerald accent
artboards.tradeoff: Most distinct from DBFlux; success becomes chartreuse and GET blue, away from HTTP client conventions

artboards.title: Garnet accent
artboards.tradeoff: Closest sibling to byzantine, strongest family feel; a red Send reads near destructive actions
